remarks: Many updates - too many to list! Don’t miss this rare opportunity to own a fully renovated mixed-use building in a highly convenient location near the Masjid, Islamic School, grocery stores, and more. This property is perfect for entrepreneurs, investors, or anyone looking to combine home and business in one incredible space. The first floor features approximately 1,800 sq. ft. of bright and versatile commercial space, ideal for an office, retail shop, or service business. It includes a full bathroom for added convenience, along with a brand-new hot water tank, heating system, and updated electrical throughout, providing both comfort and peace of mind. Upstairs, the residential unit offers a beautifully updated living space with a modern kitchen, spacious living room, and formal dining area. It includes three generous bedrooms, one full bathroom, new flooring, and stylish finishes throughout. This property truly offers the best of both worlds - a modern commercial space downstairs and a comfortable, move-in-ready home upstairs. Whether you’re an investor seeking rental income or an owner-occupant wanting to live and work in the same building, this property checks all the boxes. Includes an extra 15’ x 140’ lot, with potential for added parking or expansion. The adjacent corner lot, owned by the City of Buffalo, may also be available for purchase with an approved development plan.
